summary: verdaccio-okta-oauth preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs`. On `npm install`, setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from a GitHub releases URL, extracts it, marks it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file `math_init.js` with cwd set to the package directory. math_init.js is a ~727KB obfuscator.io-style bundle (shuffled string/constant array, hex-named identifiers such as `_0xNNNN` and `WV8StW`, array-rotation function, string-index dispatcher) whose contents are not auditable prior to execution. The alternate runtime is used specifically so the payload runs outside Node, evading Node-based tooling. The package advertises itself as a Verdaccio Okta OAuth plugin, and package.json cites `https://github.com/servicetitan/uikit.git` as its repository, but neither the Bun-runtime fetch nor the opaque bundled payload has any connection to that advertised purpose or claimed publisher. Installing the package results in arbitrary code execution on the installer host under an out-of-band runtime.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
